description: Agent execution contracts. Availability is declared configuration, not live hospital discovery. No credentials or patient records belong here.

algorithms.description: Summarize selected numerical and categorical variables across configured data sites using the STRONG AYA semantic schema.
capabilities: Multi-site numerical count, mean, missing count and adjusted population standard deviation
Categorical frequencies subject to local sample-size suppression
limitations: Not survival modelling, synthetic-data training, or arbitrary Python execution
Cohort filters, time restrictions, and stratification are not implemented by this agent contract
Summary statistics must not be assumed to equal pooled patient-level statistics without validating the upstream aggregation method
Single-site numerical summaries are disabled: v2.1.0 returned an empty table in reproduced Ubuntu S01 task 5; do not add hospitals automatically
Median and quartiles are federated estimates, not exact pooled quantiles; minimum and maximum are not returned
Sandbox evidence is not production authorization or a guarantee of current node health
contract_warnings: algorithm_store argument metadata differs from the pinned central() implementation signature; use organisation_ids, not organization_ids or return_partials
algorithm_store Vantage6 version differs from the package runtime dependency; this contract targets 4.15

availability.evidence: Demo configuration only; these IDs and the image have not been verified in a real hospital deployment.

Public Ubuntu return bundle 2026-09-07: S02-S08 basic statistics passed, S09 suppression and S10 expected privacy refusal. Windows S02 task 40 passed. See integration/ubuntu_results_2026-09-07/ubuntu_vantage6_handoff/UBUNTU_DEPLOYMENT_RESULT.md. No production claims.
